n = int(input())

MOD = 1000000007

maxDepth = 2 * n
# Initialize 3D DP array with zeros
dp = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(maxDepth + 1)] for _ in range(maxDepth + 1)]
dp[0][0][0] = 1

for depth in range(1, maxDepth + 1):
    for opened in range(depth & 1, depth + 1, 2):
        if opened - 1 >= 0:
            dp[depth][opened][0] += dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][1]
            dp[depth][opened][1] += dp[depth - 1][opened - 1][0]
        if opened + 1 <= maxDepth:
            dp[depth][opened][0] += dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][1]
            dp[depth][opened][1] += dp[depth - 1][opened + 1][0]
        dp[depth][opened][0] += 1
        dp[depth][opened][0] %= MOD
        dp[depth][opened][1] %= MOD

print(dp[maxDepth][0][1])
